4112.description_text: It’s time to crank up the heat and lose the measuring spoons because the secret to cooking is hiding in one simple motto: MORE IS MORE. In her bestselling debut cookbook, Cook This Book, Molly Baz taught the cooking essentials and put her love for mortadella and dill on blast. In More Is More, she’s teaching cooks how to level up their cooking, loosen up in front of that ripping hot pan, and seek deliciousness at all costs. (And yes, there will be more mortadella.) More Is More is a philosophy that encourages more risk-taking, better intuition, fewer exact measurements, and a “don’t stop ‘til it tastes delicious” mentality. The recipes in More Is More are fit for any day of the week and for cooks of all skill levels. Each recipe will teach a technique or flavor combination that takes Molly’s maximalist, “leave no flavor on the cutting board” approach. So crank your ovens! Grab a fat pinch of salt! And if you’re going to use an ingredient, truly use it. Just one lonely clove of garlic? Not in this cookbook! Throughout, you’ll encounter dozens of QR codes to step-by-step audio tutorials for a hands-free cook-along experience guided by Molly, plus recipe videos to help illuminate some of the trickier skills and recipes. With intoxicatingly delicious recipes, vivid photographs, and Molly's one-of-a-kind playful guidance and whimsy, More Is More will inspire cooks to embrace a fearless mindset to level up their cooking—for life. 4149.description_text: Developed by top OB/GYNs and women's health experts, the Perimenopause Support Pack is an all-in-one routine designed just for perimenopause, a chapter that lasts roughly four years (but can be up to a decade). Each daily sachet contains five capsules to support your daily nutrient needs, help relieve symptoms and support a healthy perimenopause transition.* Each Pack Includes: 2x Peri Multivitamin 1x Metabolic Support* 1x Perimenopause Complex* 1x Omega DHA + EPA Recommended For:Women in the perimenopause transition (typically age 40-55, but everyone is different!). During this time, our hormone levels start to fluctuate, which can impact everything from menstrual cycle, weight gain, mood shifts, night sweats, hot flashes and brain fog.* Developed by top OB/GYNs and women's health experts, the Perimenopause Support Pack is an all-in-one routine designed just for perimenopause, a chapter that lasts roughly four years (but can be up to a decade). Each daily sachet contains five capsules to support your daily nutrient needs, help relieve symptoms and support a healthy perimenopause transition.* Each Pack Includes: 2x Peri Multivitamin 1x Metabolic Support* 1x Perimenopause Complex* 1x Omega DHA + EPA Recommended For:Women in the perimenopause transition (typically age 40-55, but everyone is different!). During this time, our hormone levels start to fluctuate, which can impact everything from menstrual cycle, weight gain, mood shifts, night sweats, hot flashes and brain fog.* Key Ingredients Perimenopause Support Pack Stage-Specific Ingredients Key Ingredients Other Key Ingredients Vitamin B12 12 mcg as Methylated B12 Adequate B12 levels are crucial for red blood cells and energy metabolism. With age, B12 absorption decreases due to a variety of factors. Our formulation addresses this by providing an enhanced dosage (12 mcg, 500% DV) in the methylated form. Ashwagandha 125 mg Sensoril® Ashwagandha is an adaptogen that supports stress, well-being, and healthy cortisol levels. We thoughtfully included this clinically studied extract to provide support for the changes in wellbeing and stress that occur during the perimenopausal transition.* Metabolic Support 100 mg L-Carnitine + 50 mg Berberine + 50 mg Green Tea Extract As women move through perimenopause, hormonal variations often create metabolic fluctuations. We thoughtfully selected key ingredients to deliver antioxidant support for bodies navigating these changing hormonal patterns. Vitamin D 4,000 IU Vitamin D Vitamin D is important for bone and immune health - but over ⅓ women don't have sufficient Vitamin D status. This is especially critical during perimenopause —a time when bone health significantly declines due to decreasing estrogen levels. Vitamin K2 30 mcg as Menaquinone-7 (MK-7) Vitamin K2 is an important component of bone health that is often overlooked during perimenopause, when declining estrogen starts to impact bone health at an accelerated pace. We include Vitamin K as K2–a specialized form not found easily in the Western diet. It is designed to work with Vitamin D for bone health. Zinc 15 mg of Zinc Bysglycinate Chelate L-Theanine is an amino acid found in green tea, that supports overall calm and relaxation. We chose to include this as over 1 in 6 women experience changes in mood as hormones shift in perimenopause. The average diet only provides 22% of the recommended 500 mg of DHA + EPA daily, which is why it is included in our perimenopause formula. Formulated by a team of leading OB/GYNs and doulas, each daily pack includes a postnatal multivitamin, omega DHA + EPA, cognitive support blend* and beauty blend* for your body’s changing needs. Each Pack Includes: 2x Postnatal Multivitamin 1x Cognitive Support Blend* 1x Beauty Blend* 1x Omega DHA + EPA Recommended for: Women who are postpartum (up to 5 years after birth) and/or breastfeeding. Support your body up to 5 years post pregnancy (which is actually how long the postpartum period technically lasts!) with a complete daily vitamin routine. Formulated by a team of leading OB/GYNs and doulas, each daily pack includes a postnatal multivitamin, omega DHA + EPA, cognitive support blend* and beauty blend* for your body’s changing needs. Each Pack Includes: 2x Postnatal Multivitamin 1x Cognitive Support Blend* 1x Beauty Blend* 1x Omega DHA + EPA Recommended for: Women who are postpartum (up to 5 years after birth) and/or breastfeeding. Key Ingredients Mom Multi Support Pack Key Ingredients Stage-Specific Ingredients Other Key Ingredients Folate 700mcg DFE as Methylfolate Folate is important to continue to replenish even after pregnancy, which can deplete folate stores. Postpartum women only met 39% of their folate requirements from food alone. Our formula includes the active form of folate to help bridge this gap. Iron 16 mg of Iron as Ferrochel® New mothers continue to need extra iron after giving birth, with research showing that over 1 in 10 women remain iron deficient in the first year postpartum. Our formula includes a gentle form of iron specifically chosen to minimize digestive discomfort while effectively supporting healthy iron levels. Iodine 150 mcg of Iodine In the postnatal period, iodine is necessary for thyroid health and for lactating mothers whose requirements increase as it is an important component of breastmilk for child neurodevelopment. O Choline 120 mg of Choline as VitaCholine® Choline supports brain health for all postpartum women and enhances Omega-3 absorption. For breastfeeding mothers, choline needs are even higher as it is passed to the baby and supports infant brain development. Only 6% of women meet daily choline needs, which is why our prenatal vitamins work in harmony with choline-rich foods. Vitamin D 2,000 IU Vitamin D Vitamin D is essential for immune and bone health, and particularly crucial for breastfeeding mothers who need adequate levels to properly nourish their babies (and are at higher risk for deficiency!) More than 50% of women have insufficient Vitamin D levels which is why we provide 2,000 IU Vitamin D to promote optimal levels. Cognitive Support Blend 50 mg of L-Theanine, 10 mg Lutein, 2 mg Zeanxanthin While most Americans get only 1-3 mg of Lutein daily from their diet, our blend delivers a full 10 mg plus Zeaxanthin and calm-inducing L-Theanine to support early motherhood cognitive demands. For breastfeeding mothers, these nutrients offer the added benefit of supporting baby's developing visual and cognitive systems. Beauty Blend 30 mcg of Biotin and 500 mg of Collagen Peptides Our formula includes Biotin and Collagen to support postpartum hair, skin, and nail health. Because high-dose Biotin can affect thyroid test results, we've carefully selected a moderate dosage and kept it separate from our prenatal formulation where thyroid monitoring is more frequent. Iodine supplementation is recommended for at least 3 months prior to conception to ensure optimal levels before pregnancy, where it becomes important for the baby's developing brain.
